description: Na₂Mg₂NiH₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six H atoms to form distorted NaH₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent MgH₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NiH₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent MgH₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NiH₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-81°. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.48 Å. Mg is bonded to six H atoms to form distorted MgH₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgH₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaH₆ pentagonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one MgH₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaH₆ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent NiH₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-33°. There are a spread of Mg-H bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.21 Å. Ni is bonded to four H atoms to form NiH₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaH₆ pentagonal pyramids, edges with four equivalent MgH₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaH₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are two shorter (1.58 Å) and two longer (1.59 Å) Ni-H bond lengths. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded to two Na, two equivalent Mg, and one Ni atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing HNa₂Mg₂Ni trigonal bipyramids. In the second H site, H is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Mg atoms. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Mg, and one Ni atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded to two Na, two equivalent Mg, and one Ni atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing HNa₂Mg₂Ni square pyramids.
